class_example: ye ariyasaccāni vibhāvayanti, gambhīrapaññena sudesitāni. kiñ'c'āpi te honti bhusaṃ pamattā, na te bhavaṃ aṭṭhamaṃ ādiyanti.
english_translation: They who understand clearly the Noble Truths well taught by one with profound wisdom, even though they are exceedingly negligent, they do not grasp an eighth state of existence.

class_example: yāvakīvañ'ca me, bhikkhave, imesu catūsu ariyasaccesu saha tīhi parivaṭṭehi saha dvādasahi ākārehi yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ na suvisuddhaṃ ahosi,
english_translation: Monks, as long as for me, knowledge and vision were not perfectly purified with regard to the Four Noble Truths as they truly are in [their] three phases together with [their] twelve aspects

class_example: anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi, seyyathidaṃ - ekam'pi jātiṃ dve'pi jātiyo tisso'pi jātiyo catasso'pi jātiyo pañca'pi jātiyo dasa'pi jātiyo vīsam'pi jātiyo tiṃsam'pi jātiyo cattālīsam'pi jātiyo paññāsam'pi jātiyo jātisatam'pi jātisahassam'pi jātisatasahassam'pi
english_translation: I recollected manifold past lives, that is, one birth, two births, three births, four births, five births, ten births, twenty births, thirty births, forty births, fifty births, a hundred births, a thousand births, a hundred thousand births

class_example: evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paṭissutvā soḷasa aṭṭhakavaggikāni sabbāni eva sarena abhaṇi.
english_translation: "Yes, venerable sir." Having responded in agreement to the Blessed One, Venerable Soṇa indeed recited melodiously all sixteen [suttas], belonging to the groups of eight.

class_example: tassa eva kho pana bhikkhussa bhikkhū honti, anuvattakā vaggavādakā, eko vā dve vā tayo vā, te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ
english_translation: But now there are monks who are followers of just that monk, [and] who are proponents of [his] faction – one or two or three – [and] they should say thus

class_example: vanappagumbe yathā phussit'agge, gimhāna-māse paṭhamasmiṃ gimhe, tath'ūpamaṃ dhamma-varaṃ adesayi, nibbāna-gāmiṃ paramaṃ hitāya.
english_translation: Like a forest grove with a flowering crest, in the first heat of the hot month, (The Buddha) taught the sublime teaching, leading to the highest Nibbāna, for the benefit.

class_example: dissati ayaṃ, bhikkhave, cātumahābhūtiko kāyo ekaṃ api vassaṁ tiṭṭhamāno dve api vassāni tiṭṭhamāno tīṇi ... cattāri ... pañca ... dasa ... vīsati ... tiṃsaṃ ... cattārīsaṃ api vassāni tiṭṭhamāno paññāsaṃ api vassāni tiṭṭhamāno vassasataṃ api tiṭṭhamāno, bhiyyo api tiṭṭhamāno.
english_translation: It is observed, monks, [that] this body, composed of the four great elements, is standing just one year, [or] just two years ... three ... four ... five ... ten ... twenty ... thirty ... forty ... fifty [or] remaining one hundred years [or] even remaining more than [that].

class_example: dissati ayaṃ, bhikkhave, cātumahābhūtiko kāyo ekaṃ api vassaṁ tiṭṭhamāno dve api vassāni tiṭṭhamāno tīṇi ... cattāri ... pañca ... dasa ... vīsati ... tiṃsaṃ ... cattārīsaṃ api vassāni tiṭṭhamāno paññāsaṃ api vassāni tiṭṭhamāno vassasataṃ api tiṭṭhamāno, bhiyyo api tiṭṭhamāno.
english_translation: It is observed, monks, [that] this body, composed of the four great elements, is standing just one year, [or] just two years ... three ... four ... five ... ten ... twenty ... thirty ... forty ... fifty [or] remaining one hundred years [or] even remaining more than [that].

class_example: iti h'etaṃ vijānāma, navamo so parābhavo. dasamaṃ bhagavā brūhi. kiṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ?
english_translation: Indeed this we understand, [that] this [is] the ninth downfall. May the Blessed One tell [us] the tenth: What [is] the cause of the downfall?

class_example: catūhi apāyehi ca vippamutto, cha ca abhiṭhānāni abhabbo kātuṃ
english_translation: One is released from the four states of misery and is unable to perform the six heinous crimes.

class_example: ye ariyasaccāni vibhāvayanti, gambhīrapaññena sudesitāni. kiñ'c'āpi te honti bhusaṃ pamattā, na te bhavaṃ aṭṭhamaṃ ādiyanti.
english_translation: They who understand clearly the Noble Truths well taught by one with profound wisdom, even though they are exceedingly negligent, they do not grasp an eighth state of existence.

class_example: seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, mahāsamuddo ekaraso loṇaraso, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso
english_translation: Monks, just as the great ocean has one taste, the taste of salt. Likewise, monks, this teaching and training has one taste, the flavour of liberation.

class_example: evam'eva tesaṃ caturāsītīnaṃ pāṇānaṃ sahassānaṃ tasmiṃ eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
english_translation: Similarly, spotless, untainted spiritual insight arose for those eighty-four thousand beings just in that place.

class_example: dissati ayaṃ, bhikkhave, cātumahābhūtiko kāyo ekaṃ api vassaṁ tiṭṭhamāno dve api vassāni tiṭṭhamāno tīṇi ... cattāri ... pañca ... dasa ... vīsati ... tiṃsaṃ ... cattārīsaṃ api vassāni tiṭṭhamāno paññāsaṃ api vassāni tiṭṭhamāno vassasataṃ api tiṭṭhamāno, bhiyyo api tiṭṭhamāno.
english_translation: It is observed, monks, [that] this body, composed of the four great elements, is standing just one year, [or] just two years ... three ... four ... five ... ten ... twenty ... thirty ... forty ... fifty [or] remaining one hundred years [or] even remaining more than [that].

class_example: anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi, seyyathidaṃ - ekam'pi jātiṃ dve'pi jātiyo tisso'pi jātiyo catasso'pi jātiyo pañca'pi jātiyo dasa'pi jātiyo vīsam'pi jātiyo tiṃsam'pi jātiyo cattālīsam'pi jātiyo paññāsam'pi jātiyo jātisatam'pi jātisahassam'pi jātisatasahassam'pi
english_translation: I recollected manifold past lives, that is, one birth, two births, three births, four births, five births, ten births, twenty births, thirty births, forty births, fifty births, a hundred births, a thousand births, a hundred thousand births

class_example: taṃ kiṃ maññatha, api nu so puriso divasaṃ tīhi sattīhi satehi haññamāno tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyeyya?
english_translation: "What do you think? Wouldn't that man, being struck during the day with three hundred spears, experience suffering and distress on that account?"

class_example: tassa imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti, seyyath'idaṃ, cakkaratanaṃ, hatthiratanaṃ, assaratanaṃ, maṇiratanaṃ, itthiratanaṃ, gahapatiratanaṃ, pariṇāyakaratanaṃ eva sattamaṃ.
english_translation: [A Wheel-turning Monarch] has these seven treasures, namely: the wheel treasure, the elephant treasure, the horse treasure, the jewel treasure, the woman treasure, the steward treasure, [and] as the seventh, the counselor treasure.

class_example: kabaḷīkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā, phasso dutiyo, manosañcetanā tatiyā, viññāṇaṃ catutthaṃ
english_translation: heavy or refined edible food, sense contact is the second, mental volition is the third, consciousness is the fourth
